test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following events was conducted by the Ministry of Ayush, GoI to mark the 100-day countdown to the International Day of Yoga 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yoga Mahotsav.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yoga Mahotsav** was conducted by the Ministry of Ayush, GoI to mark the 100-day countdown to the International Day of Yoga 2022.
 
• **Yoga Mahotsav 2022** is a campaign that will be held for **100 days, at 100 places and will include 100 organizations**.
 
• This campaign will be organized till **21st June 2022.**
 
• The 8th edition of International Day of Yoga 2022 will be celebrated with the theme **“Yoga for Humanity”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **international yoga day** is celebrated every year on** 21st June.**

 
 
• The international yoga day was **first celebrated in 2015.**
 
• Yoga is originated in India.
 
• The idea of international yoga day was first proposed by the India prime minister Narendra Modi.
 
• Reserve Bank of India issued a 10 rupees commemorative coin to mark the first international day of yoga in 2015.
 
• The theme of International yoga day 2020 is ‘Yoga at Home and Yoga with Family’.
 
 
 
• The** world’s first Yoga University **outside India was launched as a part of yoga day celebrations in 2020.
 
 
• It was launched on **23rd June 2020.**
 
• Launched in Los Angeles city, United State.
 
• It was named as** Vivekananda Yoga University**.
